cards.b: Hypotenuse: add the squares then square root. Shorter side: subtract (c² − b²) then square root.

cards.f: How do you find an angle from two sides?
cards.b: Use the inverse function, e.g. θ = tan⁻¹(8 ÷ 11). Calculator in degrees.
Elevation: measured up from the horizontal. Depression: measured down from the horizontal.
Angle of depression from A to B = angle of elevation from B to A (alternate angles).

Bearing of A from B = bearing of B from A ± 180°. Example: 125° gives 305°.

cards.f: Bearing of B from A: where do you stand?
cards.b: At A, facing north, then turn clockwise to B.

cards.f: East and north components of a journey d on bearing θ
cards.b: East = d sin θ, north = d cos θ (for 0° < θ < 90°).

short.q: Show that a triangle with sides 9 cm, 12 cm and 15 cm is right-angled.
short.model: 9² + 12² = 81 + 144 = 225 = 15², so by the converse of Pythagoras it is right-angled.
